_comment: Ordered walkthrough steps for the guided suggestions in command-suggestions.js. 'at' = room id the command has to be typed in (the player is routed there first); 'done' = ANY of: arrive (standing in that room), item (holding that item id from commands.json), text (any substring, case-insensitive, in newly printed game output). 'gate' = reaching this step proves everything before it is moot, so earlier steps are marked done too.

steps.why: Grab the leaflet (the game's own intro)
Keep going around to the back

text: open the window far enough to allow entry

steps.why: Take the brass lantern -- you'll need light below
Take the elvish sword for the troll

text: the rug is moved to one side
reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase

steps.why: Light the lantern before going down
Fight the troll (may take several swings -- repeat it)
